scope.flow: forceExercise settlement using manipulable spot currentTick within TWAP staleness threshold
scope.environment: RiskEngine.sol exerciseCost() with Uniswap-style pool spot price and TWAP staleness check
evidence: The `exerciseCost()` function in `RiskEngine.sol` calculates exercise fees using `currentTick` (spot price) for value computation while the staleness check only ensures deviation from TWAP is under 513 ticks (~5%). An attacker can atomically manipulate the pool price by up to 512 ticks to extract value from position holders during force exercise operations.
